name: Layer stack manages opacity, blend modes, lock protection, and merge down
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball, adding a secondary shadow layer with Multiply blend mode, locking a layer and asserting paint attempts trigger locked warnings, and executing merge down.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select Flood Fill (press G), choose a bright color, and click inside the circle to solidly color it
Click the 'Layers' tab button in the right inspector panel
Click the '+ Add Layer' button to add a second layer over the ball
Change the active layer's blend mode dropdown to 'Multiply'
Click the lock icon button on the active layer to lock it
Select the Pen tool and attempt to draw on the center canvas
Verify the stroke is blocked and a warning toast appears stating 'Active layer is locked! Unlock it in the inspector to paint.'
Click the lock icon button again to unlock the layer
Click the Merge Down button, then confirm the merge step
Verify the layers merge down into a single flattened layer
